preview: Today, we look at assigned desks and shared seating, and at what people need from a place to work. Why might the way an office is arranged matter so much to how a person starts the day and works there?
comment_1: As you listen, notice the contrast between two different reactions to the same setting.
comment_2: Now, you will hear two different voices. Each person will share their own view on the question you just heard.
comment_3: You have heard two different ways of experiencing the same situation. Instead of deciding which view is right, let us ask why the situation feels different to each person. Next, we will look more closely at where that difference comes from.
comment_4: Instead of asking which person is right, let’s ask a deeper question. What is it about this situation that makes it feel different for each person?
